'''Sener''' was a member of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sener recommended the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rill (bounty hunter)|Rill]] for the mission to claim the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her father, [[Tamaron Rill]].
